messages.text: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

已查到可引用的部分資料：

| Chain level | Supported item |
|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | The Aerospace / Defense context is deployed 5G private-network resilience under Smart Jamming / EW conditions, with interest in improving resilience without modifying the DUT [19]. |
| Aerospace / Defense market drivers | The listed drivers include tactical edge connectivity needs, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, low-latency autonomous systems and drones, tactical private 5G on military bases, and secure command-and-control demand [24]. |
| Measurable parameters available in tester knowledge base | The CMX500 knowledge base lists Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, Throughput measurement, and PER measurement [6]. |
| Signaling / non-signaling tester capability | The R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. |
| Signaling / non-signaling tester workflow | The CMX500 Callbox can quickly establish a DUT connection for RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [5]. |
| Example tester use cases | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include sensitivity testing, high e2e throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [20]. |
| A&D-specific CMX500 role limitation | The knowledge base says the white paper uses CMX500 as a network emulator, but it is not a CMX500 binding specification [35]. |
【推論】Aerospace / Defense demand for resilient private 5G in smart-jamming, EW, and contested-spectrum environments can be mapped to measuring BLER, PER, throughput, and sensitivity under channel impairments such as fading and AWGN [24][6][20].
【推論】Those measurable parameters map to a required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability of one-box network emulation, DUT connection establishment, RF / mobility / application testing, and non-signaling R&D verification [6][5].
【推論】For an unmodified 5G DUT resilience scenario, the tester role is best framed as CMX500 network emulation plus signaling / non-signaling measurement coverage, not as a guaranteed product specification for that A&D use case [35][6][5].

[24] Wiki：5G private network resilience against smart jamming（來源：`2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.md`、`5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.md`）

Randy Schnell
[[Randy Schnell]] 是 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 封面列名的 Business Development Manager，Aerospace & Defense Test。

PARPRO › unresolved
- 需要擷取 `https://www.parpro.com.tw/solutions/aerospace-defense/` 正文。
- 需要確認 [[PARPRO]] 的正式公司名稱、所在地、產品線、產業分類與認證。
- 需要 OCR 來源中與該 URL 相鄰的圖片，確認是否為 PARPRO aerospace & defense 內容。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › RACH-less LTM requirements
用於 TC 7.1.1.3.28、7.1.1.3.28A.x、7.1.1.3.30、7.1.1.5.11 與 7.1.3.5.14 的 [[RACH-less LTM]] additional requirements：

- Target DRB pre-configuration：`f_NR_SS_CommonRadioBearerConfig` before switch。
- Target [[C-RNTI]] assignment with FollowOnFlag：`f_NR_SS_C_RNTI_Config(FollowOnFlag=true)`。
- Target UL grant OnSR：`f_NR_ULGrantConfiguration_Common(cs_UL_GrantConfig_OnSR)`。
- [[RRCReconfigurationComplete]] on target SRB1：`SRB.receive(car_NR_SRB1_RrcPdu_IND)`。
- Source cell cleanup：`f_NR_SS_SRBs_DRBs_Release` + `f_NR_SS_SRBs_DRBs_Config(omit)`。
- UL grant stop on source：`f_NR_ULGrantConfiguration_Stop`。

- RF

EMITE
[[EMITE]] 是位於西班牙的 OTA Test Systems 公司；[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 稱其與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力整合到 EMITE over-the-air chambers，以支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] OTA measurements。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Program / roadmap 脈絡
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把 private 5G resilience 放入 defense / Future-G roadmap：

| 期間 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 2025–2028 | widespread deployment of 5G tactical networks；mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；hybrid commercial / military networks such as 5G.MIL-style architectures |
| 2028–2032 | 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios replacing multi-radio tactical stacks；early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection and perimeter defense；[[URLLC]] services for autonomy |
| 2032–2035+ | full 6G networks with integrated sensing；AI-native battlefield connectivity；high-precision location sensing and spectrum-aware autonomy |

來源也列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] 與 [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing programs，作為 FHSS 與 5G convergence 的 program examples。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。

- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › RACH-based LTM requirements
用於 TC 7.1.1.1.28、7.1.1.1.29、7.1.1.1.30、7.1.1.3.29、7.1.2.3.12、7.1.3.5.13、7.1.3.5.15 與 7.1.3.5.14A.x 的 [[RACH-based LTM]] additional requirements：

- [[PDCCH order]] / DCI 1_0：`cads_NR_DciTriggerPDCCHOrder_REQ`。
- Cross-cell PDCCH order / CellIndicator bit：`cds_NR_PDCCH_Order_CellInd`。
- PRACH preamble indication：`cds_NR_SystemIndCtrl_RachPreamble` + `SYSIND.receive(car_NR_PRACH_Preamble_IND)`。
- RACH no-response mode for [[T304]] testing：`cs_NR_RachProcedureConfig_NoResponse`。
- Target cell [[CFRA]]：`cs_NR_RachProcedureConfig_CFRA`。
- RACH re-initialization：`f_NR_InitialiseRachProcedure`。
- Target timing advance / physical layer uplink configuration：`cads_NR_CellConfigPhysicalLayerUplink`。

passages.text:
NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。
- satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。

這些問題把 NTN 測試需求拆成 orbit、payload 與 gateway integration，而不是只停留在 waveform / protocol 名稱。

EMITE › 與 Rohde & Schwarz 的合作
[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 說明 [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 延續合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester 的 latest test capabilities fully integrated 到 [[EMITE]] OTA measurement solutions。

來源中的合作重點：

- [[EMITE]] state-of-the-art over-the-air chambers 可與 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新 testing features combined。
- 整合能力涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- 對 EMITE customers 的目標是提供 comprehensive environment，用於 assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是整合 [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]] test capabilities；來源稱兩者 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

passages.text:
R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › 重點摘要
本來源是 Rohde & Schwarz confidential 文件《LTM TTCN-3 Test Cases - SS Stack Requirements Analysis (IWD_26wk24)》，標示 Generated: 2026-06-26，Source: IWD_26wk24 TTCN-3 codebase，整理 [[L1-L2 Triggered Mobility]]（LTM）TTCN-3 test cases 對 [[SS Stack LTM Requirements]] 的能力需求。來源列出 Total LTM Test Cases: 17，涵蓋 [[RACH-based LTM]]、[[RACH-less LTM]]、[[NR-DC]] LTM、[[Carrier Aggregation]] LTM，以及 [[RLC]] / [[PDCP]] persistence、NoResetID、DRX、CFRA、T304、LBT failure 等測試子集合。

來源不是 3GPP 標準全文，而是從 TTCN-3 codebase 反推出的 test implementation requirements；因此其中的 API / template 名稱（例如 `cas_NR_MacCommandTrigger_REQ`、`cs_LTM_CellSwitch_CE`、`f_NR_SS_ConfigLTM_TCI`）應視為 SS stack / test harness 需求，不可直接推論為 [[3GPP TS 38.321]]、[[3GPP TS 38.331]] 或 [[3GPP TS 38.508-1]] 的正式條文內容。

answer.text:
| Chain level | Supported item |
|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | The Aerospace / Defense context is deployed 5G private-network resilience under Smart Jamming / EW conditions, with interest in improving resilience without modifying the DUT [19]. |
| Aerospace / Defense market drivers | The listed drivers include tactical edge connectivity needs, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, low-latency autonomous systems and drones, tactical private 5G on military bases, and secure command-and-control demand [24]. |
| Measurable parameters available in tester knowledge base | The CMX500 knowledge base lists Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, Throughput measurement, and PER measurement [6]. |
| Signaling / non-signaling tester capability | The R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. |
| Signaling / non-signaling tester workflow | The CMX500 Callbox can quickly establish a DUT connection for RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [5]. |
| Example tester use cases | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include sensitivity testing, high e2e throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [20]. |
| A&D-specific CMX500 role limitation | The knowledge base says the white paper uses CMX500 as a network emulator, but it is not a CMX500 binding specification [35]. |
【推論】Aerospace / Defense demand for resilient private 5G in smart-jamming, EW, and contested-spectrum environments can be mapped to measuring BLER, PER, throughput, and sensitivity under channel impairments such as fading and AWGN [24][6][20].
【推論】Those measurable parameters map to a required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability of one-box network emulation, DUT connection establishment, RF / mobility / application testing, and non-signaling R&D verification [6][5].
【推論】For an unmodified 5G DUT resilience scenario, the tester role is best framed as CMX500 network emulation plus signaling / non-signaling measurement coverage, not as a guaranteed product specification for that A&D use case [35][6][5].

cited_passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Randy Schnell › 來源中的列名
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- 封面列名：Randy Schnell。
- 職稱 / 角色列名：Business Development Manager。
- 組織 / 業務領域列名：Aerospace & Defense Test。
- 簡報主題為 deployed [[5G]] private networks 在 [[Smart Jamming]] / [[EW]] 環境下的 resilience，以及 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] 能否在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下提升連線韌性。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。
